intro.en: A Godello from six high-altitude estate parcels in Santa Cruz do Bolo. Old vines on decomposed granite, barrel fermentation and lees ageing define As Sortes: concentrated and textured, with a firm line of acidity.
intro.zh: 来自 Santa Cruz do Bolo 六处高海拔自有地块的 Godello。风化花岗岩上的老藤、桶发酵与酒泥熟成共同塑造 As Sortes：浓缩而富于质地，酸度清晰。

text.en: Rafael Palacios established his Valdeorras project in 2004 after leaving the family business in Rioja. The Bibei valley’s old Godello vines became the focus of his work.
text.zh: Rafael Palacios 离开 Rioja 的家族事业后，于 2004 年在 Valdeorras 开展自己的项目，专注 Bibei 河谷的老藤 Godello。

text.en: Sorte refers to an inherited parcel allocated by drawing lots. As Sortes combines six parcels acquired between 2004 and 2007; it is a multi-parcel estate wine.
text.zh: Sorte 与通过抽签分配继承地块的传统有关。As Sortes 来自 2004–2007 年间购入的六个地块，属于多地块自有葡萄园酒。

text.en: Santa Cruz do Bolo, on the northern side of the Bibei valley; above 680 m. The northern side of a valley should not be confused with the aspect of each individual parcel.
text.zh: Santa Cruz do Bolo，位于 Bibei 河谷北侧，海拔超过 680 米。河谷北侧的位置与每个具体地块的坡向应分别理解。

text.en: The six parcels were planted in the late 1970s and early 1980s, using Godello material recovered from traditional old vines through Proyecto Revival.
text.zh: 六处地块种植于 1970 年代末至 1980 年代初，采用通过 Proyecto Revival 从传统老藤恢复的 Godello 材料。

text.en: Low-fertility granite sand. The steep, terraced landscape requires careful soil management to protect the shallow, easily eroded ground.
text.zh: 低肥力的花岗岩砂土。陡坡梯田需要谨慎管理，保护浅薄且易侵蚀的土壤。

text.en: The estate describes organic treatments and biodynamic working methods. The historical importer sheet records hand work and hand harvesting. Current practice is distinguished from a current certification claim.
text.zh: 酒庄描述使用有机处理及生物动力耕作方法；历史进口商技术表记录人工田间作业与手工采收。耕作实践与当前认证状态分别记录。

text.en: Grapefruit and apple, with floral and herbal nuances. The 2023 importer note adds citrus and white stone fruit; these are source tasting descriptions, rather than a personal tasting record.
text.zh: 葡萄柚、苹果，伴随花香与草本细节。2023 年进口商品鉴资料另提到柑橘及白色核果；此处为来源品鉴描述整理。

text.en: A rich, broad texture held by fresh acidity and a long finish. The estate’s description combines a taut opening with greater warmth and breadth toward the finish.
text.zh: 质地饱满、宽阔，以清新酸度支撑，余味绵长。酒庄描述的口感从紧致的入口，逐渐展开为更温暖、有包裹感的后段。

text.en: The 2022 importer recommends cellaring beyond ten years. Its published note emphasises a firm acid structure, saline finish and an increasingly complex savoury profile. Storage and bottle condition remain decisive.
text.zh: 2022 年进口商资料给出十年以上陈年潜力，强调酸度结构、咸鲜余味及随时间发展的复杂风味；实际表现仍取决于储存与瓶况。

text.en: Start at 10–12°C and allow the wine to warm gradually in the glass.
text.zh: 从 10–12°C 开始饮用，让杯中酒温自然上升。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: use a generous white-wine glass. Taste first, then aerate a closed young bottle progressively; assess mature bottles individually.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：使用杯肚较宽的白葡萄酒杯。年轻酒先试饮，再根据封闭程度逐步透气；老年份按瓶况决定。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: roast turbot with a light beurre blanc, or roast chicken with mushrooms. Match the wine’s weight and texture without overwhelming its acidity.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：烤多宝鱼配轻盈的白黄油汁，或蘑菇烤鸡；用菜肴的质地对应酒体，同时保留酸度的清晰感。

season.en: A mild, wet winter replenished soil water. A warm, largely dry summer was followed by useful September rain, supporting the final stages of ripening.
season.zh: 温和多雨的冬季补充了土壤水分；夏季温暖、总体干燥，九月适时降雨帮助最后阶段的成熟。

text.en: Grapes are pressed before fermentation with indigenous yeasts.
text.zh: 先压榨葡萄，再以原生酵母发酵。

text.en: 500-litre French oak barrels.
text.zh: 500 升法国橡木桶。

text.en: Eight months on lees in barrel before bottling.
text.zh: 装瓶前在桶内带酒泥熟成八个月。

text.en: The 2023 sources do not specify new-oak percentage, MLF, stirring frequency or a fermentation temperature.
text.zh: 2023 年份资料未列新桶比例、MLF、搅桶频率及发酵温度。

season.en: A hot, dry growing season was followed by September rain. The importer describes a fresher result than the season might suggest, with ripeness supported by acidity.
season.zh: 生长季炎热干燥，九月出现降雨。进口商描述该年份比季节条件所暗示的更为清新，成熟度仍有酸度支撑。

text.en: Hand harvested; indigenous-yeast fermentation.
text.zh: 手工采收；原生酵母发酵。

text.en: 500-litre oak vessels; eight months on lees.
text.zh: 500 升橡木容器；带酒泥熟成八个月。

text.en: The importer records fining and filtration. Its reproduced Wine Advocate note reports bottling in June 2023 and 22,200 bottles.
text.zh: 进口商记载进行澄清与过滤；其转引的 Wine Advocate 记录为 2023 年六月装瓶、产量 22,200 瓶。

text.en: Not specified for this vintage in the cited source.
text.zh: 引用来源未列这一年份的新桶比例与 MLF。

notes.en: The historical European Cellars / Indigo Wine sheet lists 20% new oak and 7–8 months of ageing. It is retained as a historical source, not applied as a confirmed 2023 specification.
notes.zh: 历史 European Cellars／Indigo Wine 技术表列有 20% 新桶及 7–8 个月熟成，保留作历史资料，不套用为已确认的 2023 年份数据。

notes.en: The estate gives planting dates, while older trade sheets give varying vine-age ranges. Planting dates are retained rather than displaying an automatically ageing “40-year-old vines” claim.
notes.zh: 酒庄列出种植年代，而旧贸易资料的藤龄范围不同。本页保留种植年代，不将“40 年老藤”当作永远不变的数值。

intro.en: An estate Godello assembled from parcels around four villages in O Bolo. Large foudres and a shorter period on fine lees give Louro its own place in the range.
intro.zh: 来自 O Bolo 四个村庄周边自有地块的 Godello。大木桶与较短的细酒泥熟成，构成 Louro 在酒庄系列中的独立表达。

text.en: Rafael Palacios, established in O Bolo in 2004, with a focus on Godello from the Bibei valley.
text.zh: Rafael Palacios 于 2004 年在 O Bolo 建立项目，专注 Bibei 河谷 Godello。

text.en: Chandoiro, Lentellais, Outardepregos and Santa Cruz do Bolo. The parcels lie above 600 m.
text.zh: Chandoiro、Lentellais、Outardepregos 与 Santa Cruz do Bolo；地块海拔超过 600 米。

text.en: Sandy granite, including sand with clay deposits. The estate describes vines averaging 25 years in its undated profile.
text.zh: 花岗岩砂土，亦有带黏土沉积的砂土。酒庄无明确年份的通用介绍将平均藤龄记为 25 年。

text.en: The producer describes a return to traditional organic methods, with treatments chosen to protect vines and soils.
text.zh: 酒庄强调恢复传统、有机耕作方法，避免损害葡萄藤与土壤的处理。

text.en: Lemon peel, orange blossom, fennel and stony nuances in the importer’s 2023 note.
text.zh: 进口商 2023 年品鉴描述包括柠檬皮、橙花、茴香及石质气息。

text.en: Concentrated fruit and broad texture, supported by bright acidity and a saline finish.
text.zh: 浓缩果味与宽阔质地，由明亮酸度及咸鲜余味支撑。

text.en: Serve initially around 10–12°C in a generous white-wine glass. Assess aeration from the first taste; the bottle’s age and condition determine the approach.
text.zh: 可从约 10–12°C 开始，使用杯肚较宽的白葡萄酒杯。先试饮再决定透气方式，并根据酒龄与瓶况调整。

text.en: Match textured, savoury dishes: roast fish, poultry or mushrooms. Keep the sauce intensity in balance with the wine.
text.zh: 可搭配具有质地与鲜味的烤鱼、禽类或蘑菇，并使酱汁强度与酒款保持平衡。

season.en: Mild, wet winter; a warm and mainly dry summer; September rain helped complete ripening.
season.zh: 冬季温和多雨，夏季温暖且主要为干燥天气，九月降雨帮助完成成熟。

text.en: Grapes are pressed before fermentation in 35-hectolitre French oak foudres (3,500 litres).
text.zh: 葡萄压榨后，在 35 百升的法国橡木大桶中发酵，即 3,500 升。

text.en: Four months on fine lees before bottling.
text.zh: 装瓶前在细酒泥上熟成四个月。

text.en: The 2023 factsheet names Pablo Blanco Vilachá. The estate project is led by Rafael Palacios.
text.zh: 2023 年份技术表列酿酒师为 Pablo Blanco Vilachá；酒庄项目由 Rafael Palacios 主导。

notes.en: The 2023 trade factsheet specifies 100% Godello. Do not transfer that percentage automatically to other Louro vintages.
notes.zh: 2023 年贸易技术表明确为 100% Godello，不将该比例自动套用到 Louro 其他年份。

intro.en: A single-parcel Godello from ungrafted bush vines planted in 1920. Skin fermentation adds a fine phenolic texture to this concentrated, high-altitude white.
intro.zh: 来自 1920 年种植、自根灌木形老藤的单一地块 Godello。带皮发酵为这款高海拔、浓缩型白葡萄酒增添细致的酚类质地。

text.en: Rafael Palacios, established in O Bolo in 2004, with a focus on Godello from the Bibei valley.
text.zh: Rafael Palacios 于 2004 年在 O Bolo 建立项目，专注 Bibei 河谷 Godello。

text.en: A 0.24 ha parcel in Santa Cruz do Bolo, facing north at 680 m.
text.zh: Santa Cruz do Bolo 的 0.24 公顷地块，朝北，海拔 680 米。

text.en: Planted in 1920; ungrafted, bush-trained Godello. The estate records small bunches and low yields.
text.zh: 1920 年种植的自根、灌木形 Godello，酒庄记载其果穗小、产量低。

text.en: Shallow granite soils, described by the estate as lacking mica. The soil is not tilled; dry-straw mulch helps conserve summer moisture. Biodynamic farming.
text.zh: 浅薄的花岗岩土壤，酒庄指出其中缺少云母。不翻耕，以干草覆盖保持夏季水分，并采用生物动力耕作。

text.en: Grapefruit and tangerine peel, with a lifted floral character.
text.zh: 葡萄柚与橘皮，伴随扬起的花香。

text.en: A concentrated citrus core, fine pithy grip, refreshing salinity and a long finish. The importer relates its style to traditional brisado wines.
text.zh: 浓缩的柑橘核心，细致的果皮抓口感、清新咸鲜感及绵长余味；进口商将其联系到传统 brisado 风格。

text.en: Serve initially around 10–12°C in a generous white-wine glass. Assess aeration from the first taste; the bottle’s age and condition determine the approach.
text.zh: 可从约 10–12°C 开始，使用杯肚较宽的白葡萄酒杯。先试饮再决定透气方式，并根据酒龄与瓶况调整。

text.en: Match textured, savoury dishes: roast fish, poultry or mushrooms. Keep the sauce intensity in balance with the wine.
text.zh: 可搭配具有质地与鲜味的烤鱼、禽类或蘑菇，并使酱汁强度与酒款保持平衡。

season.en: A mild, wet winter preceded a dry, temperate summer. Early-September rain supported phenolic ripeness.
season.zh: 温和多雨的冬季之后是干燥、温和的夏季；九月初降雨帮助酚类成熟。

text.en: Destemmed grapes; indigenous yeasts; skin fermentation in 1,500-litre open oak vats, followed by a gentle, quick pressing.
text.zh: 葡萄去梗，以原生酵母在 1,500 升敞口橡木槽中带皮发酵，之后轻柔、快速压榨。

text.en: Nine months on fine lees in third-use, 500-litre French oak barrels.
text.zh: 在第三次使用的 500 升法国橡木桶中，带细酒泥熟成九个月。

text.en: The undated estate page describes approximately one month on skins and twelve months in used barrels. These are kept separate from the 2023 specification.
text.zh: 酒庄无明确年份的通用介绍记载约一个月带皮发酵、旧桶熟成十二个月；与 2023 年份数据分开记录。

notes.en: Nine months is the cited 2023 élevage; twelve months is the undated estate description. The difference is shown rather than silently reconciled.
notes.zh: 九个月为引用的 2023 年份熟成数据；十二个月为无明确年份的酒庄介绍。本页保留差异，不擅自统一。

intro.en: A single terraced parcel in Santa Cruz do Bolo, planted in 1978 at 710 m. An original low-vigour Godello selection combines concentrated fruit with the freshness of an exposed, elevated site.
intro.zh: Santa Cruz do Bolo 的单一梯田地块，1978 年种植，海拔 710 米。原始低活力 Godello 材料，将浓缩果味与高海拔、通风地块的清新感结合。

text.en: Rafael Palacios, established in O Bolo in 2004, with a focus on Godello from the Bibei valley.
text.zh: Rafael Palacios 于 2004 年在 O Bolo 建立项目，专注 Bibei 河谷 Godello。

text.en: South-west-facing at 710 m, on the northern side of the Bibei valley; exposed to a continuous breeze.
text.zh: 西南向，海拔 710 米，位于 Bibei 河谷北侧，持续受到微风影响。

text.en: Planted in 1978 with an original low-vigour Godello clone. The estate has used these vines for massal selection for new plantings.
text.zh: 1978 年以原始低活力 Godello 克隆种植，酒庄亦以这里的葡萄藤进行群体选种，供新地块栽植。

text.en: Granite-derived fine sand with quartz schist.
text.zh: 花岗岩风化的细砂，伴随石英片岩。

text.en: Traditional cultivation with horses and biodynamic methods. The estate relates pruning and harvest timing to the lunar calendar.
text.zh: 以马匹参与传统耕作，采用生物动力方法；酒庄将修剪及采收时间与月相日历相联系。

text.en: Fresh floral notes; the estate’s separate general description also points to tangerine peel and magnolia.
text.zh: 2022 年品鉴资料以清新花香为重点；酒庄另行提供的通用描述亦提及橘皮与木兰花。

text.en: Substantial weight with freshness and a long, mineral-associated finish, despite the warm vintage.
text.zh: 尽管年份温暖，仍以清新感承托饱满重量，余味绵长，并有矿物感相关描述。

text.en: Serve initially around 10–12°C in a generous white-wine glass. Assess aeration from the first taste; the bottle’s age and condition determine the approach.
text.zh: 可从约 10–12°C 开始，使用杯肚较宽的白葡萄酒杯。先试饮再决定透气方式，并根据酒龄与瓶况调整。

text.en: Match textured, savoury dishes: roast fish, poultry or mushrooms. Keep the sauce intensity in balance with the wine.
text.zh: 可搭配具有质地与鲜味的烤鱼、禽类或蘑菇，并使酱汁强度与酒款保持平衡。

season.en: A hot, drought-affected growing season. September rain led to a delayed harvest; old vines handled the dry conditions well according to the importer.
season.zh: 生长季炎热干旱；九月降雨后延迟采收。进口商描述老藤较好地承受了干燥条件。

text.en: Pressing precedes fermentation in 500-litre French oak barrels.
text.zh: 先压榨，再在 500 升法国橡木桶中发酵。

text.en: A further eight months in barrel before bottling.
text.zh: 装瓶前继续在桶内熟成八个月。

text.en: The cited 2022 sheet does not publish a new-oak percentage, MLF treatment or lees-stirring schedule.
text.zh: 引用的 2022 年份技术表未公布新桶比例、MLF 处理及搅桶安排。

profiles.name: Bouzeron
profiles.imageCredit: Domaine de Villaine · producer bottle image

intro.en: An Aligoté Doré village wine from Bouzeron. The 2024 release combines 17 plots and balances floral lift with a rounded palate.
intro.zh: Bouzeron 村庄级 Aligoté Doré 白葡萄酒。2024 年份汇集 17 处地块，花香与圆润质地相互平衡。

text.en: The domaine is based in Bouzeron, in the Côte Chalonnaise between Santenay and Rully.
text.zh: 酒庄位于 Côte Chalonnaise 的 Bouzeron，处于 Santenay 与 Rully 之间。

text.en: The estate describes a limestone-rich, nutrient-poor hillside setting within a sheltered, warm valley. Viticulture here dates to medieval Cluniac activity.
text.zh: 酒庄描述当地为谷地中的贫瘠石灰质坡地，微气候较温暖；葡萄种植传统可追溯到中世纪 Cluny 修士。

text.en: Upper-slope plots with white marl; the producer links freshness to their exposure and position.
text.zh: 位于上坡的白色泥灰岩地块；酒庄将清新感与坡向、坡位联系起来。

text.en: The estate reports organic certification since 1986, vegetal compost, severe pruning and selective thinning when needed.
text.zh: 酒庄记载自 1986 年起获得有机认证，使用植物堆肥，通过短梢修剪及必要时疏果控制产量。

text.en: The producer describes hawthorn, acacia and chalk, a dense yet fresh palate, and a slight bitter finish.
text.zh: 酒庄描述山楂花、刺槐花与白垩气息，口感密集而清新，收尾带轻微苦感。

text.en: The estate suggests 2–3 years for primary fruit or up to ten years for greater breadth.
text.zh: 酒庄建议在 2–3 年内欣赏果味，也可陈放至约十年以发展更宽厚的质地。

text.en: Producer guidance: approximately 12°C; seafood or cheeses including goat cheese and Beaufort.
text.zh: 酒庄建议：约 12°C；可配海鲜、山羊奶酪或 Beaufort 等奶酪。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: use a medium white-wine glass; taste before deciding whether additional air is useful.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：中等杯肚白葡萄酒杯，先试饮再决定是否需要透气。

season.en: The 2024 sheet discusses fruit maturity and site influence, without harvest dates or a full weather report.
season.zh: 2024 技术表讨论成熟度及地块影响，未列采收日期或完整气候记录。

text.en: Hand harvested and sorted; slow pneumatic pressing.
text.zh: 手工采收、分拣；气囊压榨机缓慢压榨。

text.en: Temperature-controlled tanks or oak tuns; precise vessel proportions and élevage duration are not stated.
text.zh: 在控温罐或大型橡木桶中发酵；具体容器比例及熟成时间未列。

notes.en: No analytical sheet is supplied: ABV, total acidity, residual sugar and pH remain unfilled. The bottle image identifies the cuvée and need not show the selected vintage.
notes.zh: 未取得分析检测表，酒精度、总酸、残糖与 pH 留空。瓶图用于识别酒款，其标签年份未必对应所选年份。

profiles.name: Clos des Monts-Luisants Monopole
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Nuits · Morey-Saint-Denis

intro.en: A white premier cru made entirely from Aligoté, with surviving plantings from 1911. Its vineyard history and old-barrel élevage are central to the wine.
intro.zh: 完全以 Aligoté 酿造的一级园白葡萄酒，保留 1911 年种植的葡萄藤。历史种植材料与旧桶熟成是理解这款酒的重点。

text.en: William Ponsot acquired Clos des Monts-Luisants in 1872. After phylloxera, the white parcel was replanted to Aligoté in 1911. Estate bottling began in 1921.
text.zh: William Ponsot 于 1872 年购入 Clos des Monts-Luisants；根瘤蚜灾害后，白葡萄地块在 1911 年重新种植 Aligoté。酒庄自 1921 年开始自行装瓶。

text.en: A conservatory established in 2018 preserves material from the estate’s 1911 Aligoté and oldest Pinot Noir vines.
text.zh: 2018 年建立的种植材料保育园保存酒庄 1911 年 Aligoté 及最老 Pinot Noir 的遗传材料。

text.en: 1 ha; 85% planted in 1911 and 15% in 2006; 11,000 vines/ha.
Lean clay and calcareous scree over White Oolite and Dijon-Corton limestone.
text.zh: 贫瘠黏土与石灰质碎屑，基岩为 White Oolite 及 Dijon-Corton 石灰岩。

text.en: Sustainable farming, goblet pruning; target 35 hl/ha and average 4,500 bottles.
text.zh: 可持续耕作、杯状整形；目标产量 35 百升/公顷，平均约 4,500 瓶。

text.en: Vineyard Brands’ Daniel Haas recorded pineapple and lemon-cream fruit, with spice, almond and brioche notes. This historical tasting describes 2007, not every release.
text.zh: Vineyard Brands 的 Daniel Haas 在 2007 年份记录了菠萝、柠檬奶油果味，以及香料、杏仁和布里欧修气息。这是历史年份参照，不代表所有年份。

text.en: A current-vintage sensory assessment is not supplied by the cited producer sheet.
text.zh: 引用的酒庄技术表未提供当前具体年份的品鉴记录。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: begin at 11–13°C; reassess texture and aroma as the wine warms.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：从 11–13°C 开始，随升温观察香气与质地。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: a medium-to-large white-wine glass. Taste before decanting; aerate gradually if closed. For mature bottles, judge condition individually.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：中至大杯肚白葡萄酒杯。先试饮，再依封闭程度逐步透气；老年份按实际瓶况处理。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: roast turbot with a light butter sauce; mature examples may suit mushroom-based dishes.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：烤多宝鱼配轻盈黄油汁；成熟年份可尝试蘑菇类菜肴。

season.en: Cuvée specifications; the cited technical source is undated. No vintage weather account is supplied.
season.zh: 酒款通用参数；引用技术资料未注明年份，未提供对应年份的气候记录。

text.en: Manual harvest, vineyard sorting, direct whole-bunch pressing.
text.zh: 手工采收、园内分拣、整串直接压榨。

text.en: Indigenous yeasts; fermentation begins in temperature-controlled vats and continues in barrels.
text.zh: 原生酵母；先在控温罐内启动发酵，再转入桶内。

text.en: 16 months in French oak; no new wood; average barrel age 15 years.
text.zh: 法国橡木桶内 16 个月；不用新桶，桶龄平均 15 年。

notes.en: Cuvée denotes an undated wine profile, not a non-vintage wine. No current-vintage sulphur, MLF, filtration, closure or analytical specification is confirmed here.
notes.zh: Cuvée 表示未限定年份的酒款档案，并非无年份酒。当前具体年份的用硫、MLF、过滤、封口及分析数据尚未确认。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté Raisins Dorés
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Beaune · Volnay

intro.en: An old-vine Aligoté Doré from the Volnay-based Lafarge estate, documented with a 1937 planting date and organic and biodynamic certification.
intro.zh: Volnay 的 Lafarge 酒庄所酿老藤 Aligoté Doré，资料列明种植于 1937 年，具有有机及生物动力认证。

text.en: Based in Volnay, Côte de Beaune. The family’s estate also grows Pinot Noir and Chardonnay.
text.zh: 酒庄位于 Côte de Beaune 的 Volnay，另种植 Pinot Noir 及 Chardonnay。

text.en: The 2019 Corney & Barrow report records Frédéric working at the domaine since 1978 and Clothilde joining in 2018; Michel Lafarge died in January 2020.
text.zh: Corney & Barrow 的 2019 年份报告记载 Frédéric 自 1978 年起在酒庄工作，Clothilde 于 2018 年加入；Michel Lafarge 于 2020 年一月去世。

text.en: 0.8 ha, planted in 1937, on deep clay-limestone soil.
text.zh: 0.8 公顷，种植于 1937 年，深厚黏土石灰质土壤。

text.en: Ecocert organic and Demeter biodynamic certification; massal selections from the domaine.
text.zh: Ecocert 有机及 Demeter 生物动力认证；采用酒庄自身的混合选种材料。

text.en: Corney & Barrow describes a flinty, lightly reductive opening, orchard fruit, a peach-like middle palate and a saline finish. The note belongs to the 2019 release.
text.zh: Corney & Barrow 描述 2019 年份以燧石及轻微还原气息开场，带果园水果，中段近白桃，收尾有咸鲜感；此描述仅对应该年份。

text.en: No current-vintage tasting is added without a corresponding source.
text.zh: 未取得对应来源的当前年份不另行填入品鉴描述。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: begin at 10–12°C; reassess texture and aroma as the wine warms.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：从 10–12°C 开始，随升温观察香气与质地。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: a medium-to-large white-wine glass. Taste before decanting; aerate gradually if closed. For mature bottles, judge condition individually.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：中至大杯肚白葡萄酒杯。先试饮，再依封闭程度逐步透气；老年份按实际瓶况处理。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: pan-fried sole, roast chicken or a mushroom tart; adjust sauce richness to the bottle’s development.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：煎比目鱼、烤鸡或蘑菇挞；酱汁浓度随瓶中成熟状态调整。

season.en: Cuvée specifications; the cited technical source is undated. No vintage weather account is supplied.
season.zh: 酒款通用参数；引用技术资料未注明年份，未提供对应年份的气候记录。

text.en: Whole-cluster pressing and ambient-yeast fermentation.
text.zh: 整串压榨，以自然酵母发酵。

text.en: Wasserman’s cuvée sheet gives 15–18 months in used barrels.
text.zh: Wasserman 酒款表列为旧桶熟成 15–18 个月。

text.en: Fining and/or filtration if needed. MLF, lees stirring and analytical values are not listed.
text.zh: 必要时澄清及／或过滤。未列 MLF、搅桶及分析检测数值。

notes.en: An undated Veritas sheet instead lists tank fermentation and 3–6 months in older barrels. The sources are not reconciled; Wasserman’s 15–18 months is retained with attribution, not imposed on every vintage.
notes.zh: 另一份未注明年份的 Veritas 技术表列罐中发酵、旧桶熟成 3–6 个月。两者尚未核实统一，本页保留 Wasserman 的 15–18 个月并注明来源，不视为每个年份的固定参数。

notes.en: The Armit bottle image accompanies its 2022 listing. The profile is cuvée-level; the pictured label does not establish this profile’s vintage.
notes.zh: Armit 瓶图来自其 2022 年份页面；本档案为酒款通用记录，图片标签不决定本页年份。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté Clos du Roy
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Nuits · Chenôve

intro.en: A single-site Aligoté Doré from Clos du Roy in Chenôve, with pre-war vines and extended used-barrel élevage. Its appellation is Bourgogne Aligoté.
intro.zh: 来自 Chenôve 的 Clos du Roy 单一地块 Aligoté Doré，采用战前老藤及较长的旧桶熟成；法定产区为 Bourgogne Aligoté。

text.en: Pataille began his domaine in 1999 after training in Beaune and Bordeaux and working as an oenologist. He is based in Marsannay.
text.zh: Pataille 在 Beaune、Bordeaux 学习并从事酿酒顾问工作后，于 1999 年创建酒庄，基地位于 Marsannay。

text.en: Wasserman dates the separate Aligoté bottlings to the 2013 vintage.
text.zh: Wasserman 记载其 Aligoté 单一地块独立装瓶项目始于 2013 年份。

text.en: Clos du Roy is the site name. This record concerns Bourgogne Aligoté, distinct from Pataille’s Chardonnay and Pinot Noir wines from the same site.
text.zh: Clos du Roy 为地块名称；本档案为 Bourgogne Aligoté，与 Pataille 来自同一地块的 Chardonnay 及 Pinot Noir 酒款分别记录。

text.en: 0.18 ha; planted 1932–1935; 270 m elevation.
Moderate east-to-southeast slope, with iron-rich reddish gravel and calcareous grèzes litées.
text.zh: 中等坡度、朝东至东南；土壤含铁，呈浅红色并富含砾石及层状石灰质碎屑。

text.en: Certified organic, with biodynamic methods.
text.zh: 有机认证，采用生物动力耕作方法。

text.en: Wasserman’s 2016 article describes citrus-led aromas, a silky opening, firm acidity and a tight chalk-like finish. The impression is concentrated and initially reserved.
text.zh: Wasserman 的 2016 年文章描述柑橘主导香气、丝滑入口、鲜明酸度及紧致白垩质感的收尾，整体集中，初开较含蓄。

text.en: The article discusses the early single-site releases; it does not establish a tasting profile for a current vintage.
text.zh: 该文章讨论早期单一地块作品，不能据此认定当前具体年份的品鉴表现。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: begin at 11–13°C; reassess texture and aroma as the wine warms.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：从 11–13°C 开始，随升温观察香气与质地。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: a medium-to-large white-wine glass. Taste before decanting; aerate gradually if closed. For mature bottles, judge condition individually.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：中至大杯肚白葡萄酒杯。先试饮，再依封闭程度逐步透气；老年份按实际瓶况处理。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: turbot or scallops with restrained butter sauces; begin with a small pour to assess reduction and acidity.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：多宝鱼或扇贝配轻盈黄油汁；先倒少量评估还原气息与酸度。

season.en: Cuvée specifications; the cited technical source is undated. No vintage weather account is supplied.
season.zh: 酒款通用参数；引用技术资料未注明年份，未提供对应年份的气候记录。

text.en: Vertical pressing; ambient-yeast fermentation.
text.zh: 立式压榨；自然酵母发酵。

text.en: 24 months in used 350-litre barrels.
text.zh: 350 升旧桶熟成 24 个月。

text.en: Minimal addition at bottling; dose and analytical sulphur values are not supplied.
text.zh: 装瓶时少量添加；未列用量或二氧化硫检测数值。

notes.en: No verified cuvée-specific producer/importer bottle image was obtained. No standalone producer website was verified; representative sources remain available below.
notes.zh: 尚未取得可核实的此款酒专属酒庄／进口商瓶图；未核实独立酒庄官网，可使用下列代理商资料。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Nuits · Marsannay
profiles.imageCredit: Skurnik Wines & Spirits · importer bottle image

intro.en: The estate’s blended Aligoté Doré. Skurnik’s 2023 sheet identifies Champ Forey and Auvonnes as its sources; source and cellar details are kept vintage-specific.
intro.zh: 酒庄的多地块 Aligoté Doré。Skurnik 的 2023 年份资料列 Champ Forey 与 Auvonnes 为来源；葡萄来源及酿造数据按年份分别记录。

text.en: Pataille is a Marsannay grower and consulting oenologist. His work includes both blended and single-site Aligoté bottlings.
text.zh: Pataille 是 Marsannay 的种植酿酒者及酿酒顾问，其 Aligoté 系列同时包含多地块及单一地块酒款。

text.en: Wasserman records Ecocert organic certification from 2008 and biodynamic methods; Skurnik describes the 2023 wine as practising biodynamic.
text.zh: Wasserman 记载 2008 年起获 Ecocert 有机认证，并采用生物动力方法；Skurnik 将 2023 酒款标为实践生物动力耕作。

text.en: 60% Champ Forey: limestone and gravel. 40% Auvonnes: clay, marl and small stones. The importer lists vines over 50 years old.
text.zh: 60% 来自 Champ Forey，石灰质及砾石土；40% 来自 Auvonnes，黏土、泥灰岩及小石块。进口商列藤龄超过 50 年。

text.en: Bibendum instead records half from Marsannay and half from Échevronne in the Hautes Côtes. This is retained as 2022 information.
text.zh: Bibendum 对 2022 年份记录为一半来自 Marsannay，另一半来自 Hautes Côtes 的 Échevronne；仅作该年份记录。

text.en: Bibendum describes depth and energy. Its reproduced critic notes add ripe yellow fruit, saline accents and an almond nuance, with a persistent finish.
text.zh: Bibendum 强调深度与活力；其转引酒评另提到成熟黄色果实、咸鲜气息及杏仁细节，余味持久。

text.en: Skurnik’s 2023 technical page does not publish a prose tasting note; the 2022 description is not relabelled as 2023.
text.zh: Skurnik 的 2023 技术页面未发布文字品鉴描述；2022 的描述不移用为 2023。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: begin at 10–12°C; reassess texture and aroma as the wine warms.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：从 10–12°C 开始，随升温观察香气与质地。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: a medium-to-large white-wine glass. Taste before decanting; aerate gradually if closed. For mature bottles, judge condition individually.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：中至大杯肚白葡萄酒杯。先试饮，再依封闭程度逐步透气；老年份按实际瓶况处理。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: grilled prawns, gougères or a lemon-dressed fish dish; keep acidity in the sauce proportionate.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：烤虾、奶酪泡芙或少量柠檬调味的鱼类；注意酱汁酸度的比例。

season.en: The importer specifies the 2023 vintage but gives no weather or harvest-date report.
season.zh: 进口商明确标注 2023 年份，但未列气候或采收日期报告。

text.en: Indigenous yeast fermentation.
text.zh: 原生酵母发酵。

text.en: Two-thirds foudre, one-third older barrels; 12 months.
text.zh: 三分之二大型木桶、三分之一旧小桶；熟成 12 个月。

text.en: Minimal addition only at bottling.
text.zh: 仅在装瓶时少量添加。

season.en: The 2022 importer page records vineyard sourcing and cellar sequence but no season account.
season.zh: 2022 进口商页面列葡萄来源及酒窖流程，未提供季节气候记录。

text.en: Natural fermentation in stainless steel.
text.zh: 不锈钢罐内自然发酵。

text.en: Old foudre, followed by four months in stainless steel before bottling; total duration is not stated.
text.zh: 旧大型木桶熟成，装瓶前再回不锈钢罐四个月；未列总熟成时间。

notes.en: The undated Wasserman sheet gives 66% used barrels and 33% tank, unlike Skurnik’s 2023 foudre/barrel proportions. These descriptions are not combined. Differences in fruit sourcing across importer pages require vintage-by-vintage verification.
notes.zh: 未标年份的 Wasserman 技术表列 66% 旧桶、33% 罐，与 Skurnik 2023 的大木桶／旧小桶比例不同，两种资料不合并。不同进口商页面的葡萄来源差异需逐年份核对。

notes.en: No standalone producer homepage was verified. The photograph is the importer’s cuvée image and may show another vintage.
notes.zh: 未核实独立酒庄官网。照片为进口商酒款示意图，可能显示其他年份。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Beaune · Volnay

intro.en: Aligoté from Monpoulain, on the flatter eastern side of Volnay. Firm acidity defines this regional white from a domaine best known for Volnay.
intro.zh: 来自 Volnay 东部平缓地带 Monpoulain 的 Aligoté。以清晰酸度为骨架，是以 Volnay 闻名的酒庄所酿的地区级白葡萄酒。

text.en: Bourgogne Aligoté; the vineyard’s location in Volnay does not make this a Volnay appellation wine.
text.zh: Bourgogne Aligoté；葡萄园位于 Volnay，不代表酒款使用 Volnay 法定产区名称。

text.en: The domaine completed its conversion to biodynamic farming in 2009.
text.zh: 酒庄于 2009 年完成生物动力耕作转换。

text.en: Two Monpoulain parcels totalled about 0.40 ha; an adjoining 0.22 ha was acquired in 2019.
text.zh: Monpoulain 原有两块葡萄园合计约 0.40 公顷；2019 年增购相邻约 0.22 公顷。

text.en: Eastern Volnay, off the hillside; relatively deep soils, high in clay and low in limestone.
text.zh: Volnay 东部，非山坡地；土层较深、黏土比例高，石灰质较少。

text.en: The producer emphasises pronounced acidity and an aromatic character; no detailed vintage tasting note is supplied.
text.zh: 酒庄强调突出的酸度与芳香特征；未提供具体年份的详细品鉴描述。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: 10–12°C; a white-wine glass. Taste before deciding on aeration.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：10–12°C；白葡萄酒杯。试饮后决定透气程度。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: oysters, grilled white fish, or a fresh goat-cheese salad.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：牡蛎、烤白肉鱼或新鲜山羊奶酪沙拉。

season.en: Cuvée-level information; no single vintage is implied.
season.zh: 酒款通用资料，不对应单一年份。

text.en: No Aligoté-specific cellar specification is published on the cited wine page.
text.zh: 所引酒款页面未列 Aligoté 专属的酿造技术参数。

notes.en: The domaine’s general cellar page principally describes red-wine extraction. Its 18-month élevage and premier-cru new-oak figures are not assigned to this Aligoté.
notes.zh: 酒庄通用酿造页面主要描述红葡萄酒浸提，因此不将其中 18 个月熟成及一级园新桶比例套用于此 Aligoté。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté
profiles.imageCredit: The Wise Old Dog · reference bottle

intro.en: Roulot’s regional Aligoté provides a stainless-steel reference in the importer’s undated technical record: fermentation and approximately one year of maturation in tank.
intro.zh: 按进口商未标年份的技术档案，Roulot 的地区级 Aligoté 是不锈钢酿造的参考：在罐中发酵并熟成约一年。

text.en: Jean-Marc Roulot took charge of the family domaine in 1989.
text.zh: Jean-Marc Roulot 于 1989 年接掌家族酒庄。

text.en: Clay and limestone. The importer lists organic certification.
text.zh: 黏土与石灰岩；进口商列有有机认证。

text.en: The undated importer sheet gives a 20–80-year vine-age range; this is a source-period figure.
text.zh: 未标年份的进口商资料列藤龄 20–80 年；此为资料记录时的范围。

text.en: SOMM100 tasting focus: assess acidity, fruit definition and lees texture. A cuvée-specific tasting note remains to be documented.
text.zh: SOMM100 品鉴关注：酸度、果味清晰度与酒泥质地。具体酒款品鉴记录待补。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: 10–12°C; a white-wine glass. Taste before deciding on aeration.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：10–12°C；白葡萄酒杯。试饮后决定透气程度。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: shellfish or gently cooked white fish.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：贝类或清淡烹调的白肉鱼。

season.en: Cuvée-level information; no single vintage is implied.
season.zh: 酒款通用资料，不对应单一年份。

text.en: Stainless steel; malolactic fermentation takes place.
text.zh: 不锈钢罐发酵；进行苹果酸乳酸发酵。

text.en: Light lees stirring every three to four weeks until MLF; stainless-steel ageing, bottled after one year.
text.zh: MLF 前每三至四周轻搅酒泥；在不锈钢罐中熟成，一年后装瓶。

notes.en: This is an undated importer specification, not a guarantee of identical vessels or ageing for every vintage. Current analytical data are not supplied.
notes.zh: 此为未标年份的进口商技术资料，不代表每个年份的容器及熟成都完全相同；未提供当前年份分析数据。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Beaune · Meursault

intro.en: A regional Aligoté entirely from the Meursault commune. The domaine describes a fresh, dry, moderately weighted white with the capacity to develop in bottle.
intro.zh: 葡萄全部来自 Meursault 村的地区级 Aligoté。酒庄描述其清新、干型、酒体适中，并具瓶陈潜力。

text.en: Domaine Pierre Morey; Bourgogne Aligoté regional appellation.
text.zh: Domaine Pierre Morey；Bourgogne Aligoté 地区级法定产区。

text.en: 1.86 ha; the estate gives 1969 as the average planting year.
text.zh: 1.86 公顷；酒庄所列平均种植年份为 1969 年。

text.en: All parcels are in Meursault, with relatively deep clay and chalk soils.
text.zh: 全部地块位于 Meursault，土层较深，为黏土与白垩质土壤。

text.en: Dry, fresh and fruit-driven, with good acidity and moderate weight. The domaine notes ageing potential beyond early drinking.
text.zh: 干型，清新而突出果味，酸度良好、酒体适中；酒庄指出可在年轻时饮用，也具继续陈年的潜力。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: 10–12°C; a white-wine glass. Taste before deciding on aeration.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：10–12°C；白葡萄酒杯。试饮后决定透气程度。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: river fish, shellfish, or a light cream sauce.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：淡水鱼、贝类或轻盈奶油汁菜肴。

season.en: Cuvée-level information; no single vintage is implied.
season.zh: 酒款通用资料，不对应单一年份。

text.en: Twelve months, mostly in tanks, to retain freshness and fruit.
text.zh: 熟成 12 个月，主要使用罐体，以保留清新感和果味。

notes.en: The general profile says tanks, not specifically stainless steel. Vessel proportions vary in the vintage notes; no fixed oak percentage is assigned here.
notes.zh: 通用档案写的是罐体，并未指定不锈钢。年份资料显示容器比例可能变化，因此此处不设置固定橡木比例。

intro.en: Claire Naudin’s old-vine Aligoté, sold as Vin de France. Le Clou 34 takes its name from a Corgoloin parcel planted in 1934.
intro.zh: Claire Naudin 的老藤 Aligoté，以 Vin de France 标示。Le Clou 34 得名于 Corgoloin 一块种于 1934 年的葡萄园。

text.en: Claire Naudin has managed the family domaine since 1994.
text.zh: Claire Naudin 自 1994 年起管理家族酒庄。

text.en: Vin de France; not Bourgogne Aligoté AOC.
text.zh: Vin de France；不是 Bourgogne Aligoté AOC。

text.en: Le Clou in Corgoloin, plus five other parcels in 2023; shallow clay-limestone soils, facing east.
text.zh: 2023 年包括 Corgoloin 的 Le Clou 及另外五处地块；浅薄黏土石灰岩土壤，朝东。

text.en: The importer identifies La Croix (1953), Egoulotte (1945) and Les Tilles (1935, 1948, 1953) among the contributing sites.
text.zh: 进口商列出的其他来源包括 La Croix（1953）、Egoulotte（1945）及 Les Tilles（1935、1948、1953）。

text.en: The estate describes passion-fruit aromas with development, a rounded palate and a saline finish.
text.zh: 酒庄描述其陈年后出现百香果香气，口感圆润，余味带咸鲜感。

text.en: 10–12°C; decant if needed to release dissolved gas.
text.zh: 10–12°C；如有需要，可醒酒以释放溶解气体。

text.en: The estate suggests scallops, raw fish or spring asparagus.
text.zh: 酒庄建议搭配扇贝、生鱼或春季芦笋。

text.en: Hand harvested; slow whole-bunch pressing without added sulfites. Indigenous alcoholic and malolactic fermentations.
text.zh: 手工采收，整串缓慢压榨且不添加亚硫酸盐；原生酵母及细菌完成酒精发酵与 MLF。

text.en: Extended lees ageing; gravity bottling without filtration; a small sulfite addition at bottling.
text.zh: 长时间带酒泥熟成；重力装瓶，不过滤；装瓶时少量添加亚硫酸盐。

notes.en: *Total acidity is reproduced as reported. The producer sheet does not identify its acid-equivalent basis; compare with other wines only after confirming the unit convention.
notes.zh: *总酸按酒庄原值记录。技术表未注明酸当量基准，与其他酒款比较前须确认单位口径。

notes.en: Reference photograph shows 2022; technical data on this page are for 2023. “Fermented without sulfites” does not mean no sulfites were added at bottling.
notes.zh: 参考瓶图为 2022 年；本页技术数据对应 2023 年。“发酵不加亚硫酸盐”不等于装瓶时也没有添加。

profiles.name: Bourgogne Aligoté
profiles.origin: France · Burgundy · Côte de Beaune · Chassagne-Montrachet

intro.en: An Aligoté from Chassagne-Montrachet, fermented in used 350-litre barrels and given extended lees ageing. A reference for Aligoté with barrel-derived texture without new oak.
intro.zh: 来自 Chassagne-Montrachet，在使用过的 350 升桶中发酵并长时间带酒泥熟成，体现 Aligoté 在不使用新桶的情况下形成的桶酿质地。

text.en: Sylvain and Caroline inherited their father Jean-Marc Morey’s vineyards in stages in 2014 and 2016, establishing separate domaines.
text.zh: Sylvain 与 Caroline 于 2014、2016 年分阶段继承父亲 Jean-Marc Morey 的葡萄园，并分别建立酒庄。

text.en: 0.2665 ha in Chassagne-Montrachet; 210 m, east-facing, clay-limestone.
text.zh: Chassagne-Montrachet 的 0.2665 公顷地块；海拔 210 米、朝东、黏土石灰岩。

text.en: Planted in 1997 with clonal Aligoté; 10,000 vines/ha; trellised Guyot.
text.zh: 1997 年种植的 Aligoté 克隆选系；每公顷 10,000 株，采用架式 Guyot。

text.en: The producer presents this cuvée around freshness. Its 2023 assessment stresses balance and finesse rather than excess ripeness.
text.zh: 酒庄以清新感描述此酒；对 2023 年份的评价强调平衡与细腻，而非过熟感。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: 10–12°C; a white-wine glass. Taste before deciding on aeration.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：10–12°C；白葡萄酒杯。试饮后决定透气程度。

text.en: SOMM100 suggestion: roast white fish, mushrooms, or poultry with a light sauce.
text.zh: SOMM100 建议：烤白肉鱼、蘑菇或配轻盈酱汁的禽肉。

season.en: The producer describes alternating rain and wind without sustained extremes, followed by hot harvest conditions around 10 September.
season.zh: 酒庄描述生长季雨水与风交替出现、没有持续极端天气；9 月 10 日前后采收时气温较高。

text.en: Hand harvest; direct whole-bunch pressing; spontaneous fermentation in 350 L barrels.
text.zh: 手工采收；整串直接压榨；在 350 升桶中自然发酵。

text.en: 18 months on fine lees; no new oak.
text.zh: 细酒泥熟成 18 个月；不使用新桶。

text.en: Fined, unfiltered; bottled in February 2025.
text.zh: 澄清但不过滤；2025 年 2 月装瓶。

notes.en: The producer labels these specifications 2023; they are not applied automatically to other vintages. Analytical values and bottle size are not listed.
notes.zh: 酒庄明确将这些参数标为 2023 年份，不自动套用于其他年份；来源未列分析数值及瓶容量。
